inspected_anchors.finding: Six chess task scores and reported gains motivate interface research; the abstract-wide superiority wording is narrower than the MAIA expert comparison in Tables14/18.

Frozen specialist activations pass through a learned32-token projector; both variants receive verbal outputs. The projector and LLM are jointly trained in Stage2; empirical ablation is not a universal text impossibility theorem.

Table2 training overhead at8B is12%, not within approximately6% at every scale. Table3 calls times return tokens excludes other prompt/output/context and training costs.5M pairs,32GPUs and training steps need exact elapsed/GPU-hour accounting.
Data protocol reports100 commentary games and5000 puzzles; FEN disjointness and low-view selection have distinct leakage limits. Community-interest labels are not causal effects or intrinsic utility.
Text/template/probe baselines are selected implementations. The observed failure of a limited probe or top-k summary does not prove impossibility of a sufficient typed text channel.

Table14 Wild14B mean57 disagrees with headline49; Table15 rationale50.3 disagrees with45.8; Table17 difficulty0.67 disagrees with0.71. Raw and layout extraction agree; no corrected performance value is chosen.

Table16 describes approximately300 games and Table17 approximately1000 puzzles, unlike100/5000 protocol counts. Table17 retains XX.X for one solved result. Exact evaluated row sets and run IDs are required.

Interface and architecture ablations are reported. The paper explicitly acknowledges architecture, size and projector compatibility confounds; a ratio of correlations is not a ratio of decision benefit.

Twelve screened raters and15 positions form180 crossed judgments.130/180 and130/162 reproduce72.2% and80.2% with different tie denominators. Pooled ratio differs from average per-rater ratios when ties vary.
Stage2 description includes500K human-move-labelled examples despite earlier no-human-move-supervision language. Reward target, teacher policy and sampling clocks need explicit reconciliation.

J.3 excludes read-only get_policy from re-encoding, but J.4.3 says get_policy injects fresh32-token state. Sequential mutations and parallel reads need state-version binding; prompt forbids refusal, unsuitable for automatic adoption in bank inference.
Internal-activation access is required; closed specialist access is a stated limitation. A standard text tool result alone is not a demonstrated embedding-injection interface.
